ازدجروا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَجَرُوا (izdajarū) /iz.da.d͡ʒa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اُزْدُجِرُوا (uzdujirū) /uz.du.d͡ʒi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجِرُوا (izdajirū) /iz.da.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
